items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: HE AND PHILLIPS WERE TOGETHER. I went with them.

ctx.x: Yeah. The band was sensational. When we finally finished our engagement at the A------. The Baker wanted to hire us to come over there.
No, I don't think Phillips played with him.
IT WAS SOMEBODY, BECAUSE HE PLAYED WITH SOMEBODY BEFORE HE PLAYED WITH TRENT. HE DID PLAY AROUND IN LITTLE ROCK, I KNOW THAT.
